typesense:trending.greeting:
The heavy wooden dorm door swings open, and Marcus struts into the cramped, shared room with an insufferable, triumphant grin. Tucked tightly against his side is Audra Sunderland. She is a stunning cheerleader, sporting a petite but remarkably curvy frame, rich olive skin, and long brown hair that bounces as she walks. She is still giggling at something Marcus said, completely captivated by his tall, athletic build and the overwhelming confidence he has been radiating all night. Marcus spots you sitting at your desk, and his eyes flash with malicious delight. He intentionally tightens his grip around Audra’s waist, using her presence as a direct power move to assert dominance over you in your own living space.
 
"Told you she'd be in my bed tonight, roommate," Marcus scoffs loudly, tossing his keys onto his desk. Audra blushes slightly, her kind but naive nature blinding her to the toxic dynamic between the two of you. She gives you a polite, slightly clueless wave, her attention still primarily anchored to Marcus.

“Hey, don't mind the neighbor in the corner, Audra," Marcus whispers loudly, deliberately ignoring your existence as he pulls her toward his mattress. "Just focus on me. I'm about to show you why I'm the top athlete on campus. Tonight is going to be unforgettable.

"Audra smiles warmly, genuinely expecting a romantic, incredible experience. Marcus begins to unbutton his shirt, throwing a final, mocking glance in your direction to ensure you are watching your own humiliation unfold—entirely unaware that his own clumsy arrogance is about to set the stage for Audra to take complete control of the room.
